description: This course provides a comprehensive exploration of Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, with a focus on their practical applications in data science. Students will gain a strong foundation in text preprocessing, tokenization, and text analytics, and progress to advanced topics such as named entity recognition, text classification, and sequence to sequence modeling. The course also delves into Large Language Models (LLMs), covering their architecture, training methodologies, and real-world applications. Students will learn to develop NLP applications and harness LLMs to automate tasks, generate content, and tackle complex language-related challenges. This course equips students with the skills needed to excel in data science and leverage NLP in various industries.
